intentCoverage.report:
Checked revision a31a760cd6854b46d1cdb03561eafc76b98dea9c. Verdict: Caught. No follow-up.

Verdict: Caught

Story: SEED-413#published-refresh-lifecycle-via-vitest, "Prove published refresh lifecycle in Node Vitest", in .planning/seeds/SEED-413-renovate-dashboard-unit-tests.md.
Revision: a31a760cd6854b46d1cdb03561eafc76b98dea9c.
Promise checked: when a configured ref moves from A to B within bounds, untouched records at B reuse A's answers after one shared comparison.

Scratch checkout: detached worktree /tmp/dough-intent-coverage-a31a760 at that revision. npm install ran there because node_modules was absent. The worktree was removed after restoration.

Fault: dashboard/server/commitsBetween.ts, touchedAt. The function still computes whether the comparison names the entry, then returns that result or true, so every entry is treated as touched. PinnedMemo.unchangedSince then withholds the text held at A, and PinnedTexts.reader calls the file reader at B. The maintained test and its fixtures were left as they were. A temporary witness spec existed only for the independent observation and was deleted before the faulted maintained run.

Fixture: the unrelated-commit case's MakeMe project, the same files at A and B, comparison result ["src/app.ts"].

Maintained check: dashboard/backend-tests/observation/revision-reuse.spec.ts, "an unrelated commit: the backlog is read at B, and every other read there is answered from A after one comparison".
Catching assertion: expect(calls).toEqual([asked(paths.backlog, revisionB)]) at line 189.

Baseline: the focused command exited 0. Vitest reported 6 passed, Duration 2.52s. The named test passed.

Reach and wrong behavior: with the fault in place, a scratch witness read .planning/seeds/SEED-301-reuse.md at B after retaining it at A. The comparison named only src/app.ts, so that seed was untouched. The witness logged readerCalledAtB true and answerEqualsRetainedA true: the file reader ran at revision B, and the returned bytes still matched A's text because the fixture publishes the same text at both revisions. The maintained command then exited 1. Vitest Duration 644ms, 4 failed and 2 passed. The named test failed at line 189. The received call list kept the backlog read at B and added reads at B for the seed, the other seed, the plan, settings, and the agents and done listings. Those are the reads the assertion requires to be answered from A. The text expectations above that assertion had succeeded, which matches the witness: B's fixture bytes equal A's text. The assertion that failed is the call list.

The same command also failed the call-list assertions in the changed-seed test at line 215, the changed-backlog test at line 279, and the move-to-C test at line 379. The removed-profile and removed-record tests passed. This finding is limited to the unrelated-commit path the line 189 assertion exercises.

Restoration: git restore returned commitsBetween.ts to blob 4c66dd1919495064c60f48b8090fe569a327cd63, the pre-fault blob. HEAD remained a31a760cd6854b46d1cdb03561eafc76b98dea9c. Status and both diffs were empty, matching the clean pre-probe tree. The focused command then exited 0, 6 passed, Duration 463ms, and the named test passed. The scratch worktree was then removed.

Next proof action: leave this assertion as it is. It already fails when an untouched read is issued at B.

Prior disposition: plan 861 slice 4 already records this spec as the accepted proof that an unrelated commit answers the other reads from A after one comparison. This probe recognizes that existing proof and leaves repair decisions with the caller.
